entries.613338a45290ee85: Its feature is that it owns the in-house developed cloud PBX 'Omnia LINK.' The Business Description states that cases in which contact center and BPO service providers own in-house developed PBXs are extremely rare, and explains that Omnia LINK provides everything from basic functions to real-time text conversion of call audio and FAQ recommendations in an all-in-one package. As it is cloud-based, it can be used without restrictions on locations or home-working environments.
entries.69ffceffda8f92ba: The business provides contact center and BPO services that take on, on a one-stop basis, everything from planning and designing to training and operating client companies' operations, and develops and sells AI and DX solutions using digital technologies such as the in-house cloud PBX “Omnia LINK.” For the fiscal year ended May 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥36,322 million, and the filing's major-customer information prints ¥5,131 million for TEPCO Energy Partner, Inc. and ¥1,706 million for Pasona Inc. Through Radiant Communication Sdn. Bhd., a Malaysian company that became a subsidiary in the fiscal year ended May 2026, the company also provides AI and DX solutions overseas.

entries.d34dc96befc27f9a: In its 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2025,' the company sets as its ideal state 'a company that continues to grow healthily from roots to new shoots,' and lists three management policies: 'strong growth of Omnia LINK,' 'continued growth of distinctive contact center and BPO services,' and 'building a management foundation to support business growth.'

entries.ddcc1088647c2946: The reportable segment is a single segment, the Contact Center and BPO Business. Information by major customer lists revenue of ¥5,131 million from TEPCO Energy Partner, Incorporated and revenue of ¥1,706 million from Pasona Inc. for the fiscal year ended May 2026. The business environment section states that, against a backdrop of labor shortages and other factors, demand for call center outsourcing will continue to expand.
entries.e0f4211c295f650a: In its 'Medium-Term Management Plan 2025,' the company sets as its ideal state 'a company that continues to grow healthily from roots to new shoots,' and lists three management policies: 'strong growth of Omnia LINK,' 'continued growth of distinctive contact center and BPO services,' and 'building a management foundation to support business growth.' Its growth strategy is to grow both contact center and BPO services and sales of system solutions, including Omnia LINK, on both fronts.
entries.e1ce62e93a782a9e: Services are provided mainly to client companies in the Smart Life area (the finance, information and communications, and retail and distribution industries), a priority field, and in some cases only Omnia LINK is sold to companies that operate their own contact centers.
entries.ed088b05865bf811: The company undertakes on a one-stop basis the planning, design, training and operation of client companies' business, and also develops and sells AI and DX solutions utilizing digital technologies such as its in-house developed cloud PBX 'Omnia LINK' and others.
entries.fa7aadaff3ca25aa: Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥36,322 million, down 0.3% year on year. The MD&A explains that while new projects were won and existing projects expanded in the Smart Life area, a priority field, the company was affected by reduced workloads in certain public projects. In external sales of Omnia LINK, shipments of large-scale projects progressed, and Radiant Communication Sdn. Bhd. of Malaysia was made a consolidated subsidiary.
